review_text: I started playing this game on my phone and have probably played a couple thousand tournaments and that's the honest truth. When I found out they made a PC version on steam I jumped right on it. It keeps me going for hours and I love it. The competition is fierce and the fun is also. I highly recommend this little jewel.

Has potential to be a great little time waster if it resolves a few issues:

1. Fixed camera angle, which does not allow the player to get a better view of the field.
2. The camera can be obscured by objects. On my 3rd match it was positioned in a tree and all I could see were leaves, nothing else. I want to see where I shoot the ball, thank you.
3. There is no Quit to Windows button in the game menu, which shows this game is nothing more than a cheap, lazy mobile port.
4. The PULL mechanic is on the left side of the screen, which is another detail showing cheap, lazy mobile port to PC. Give players the option to place it on the right side of the screen, as it is more intuitive because that's where the mouse is for most players.

Again, this little game has potential, but I can't recommend it even for the low price of 5 or 6 due to these frictions.
As mentioned in the features section, this game doesn't support online multiplayer.
There is no online multiplayer.  Which for a battle royale game is insane.
